```{r}
library(RMariaDB)
library(tidyverse)
library(mdsr)
```

### Q2

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(
  MariaDB(), host = "scidb.smith.edu",
  user = "waiuser", password = "smith_waiDB", 
  dbname = "wai"
)

Measurements <- tbl(con, "Measurements")

dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM Measurements;")

dbDisconnect(con)
```

### Q3
```{r}
con <- dbConnect_scidb("airlines")

dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS n_flights
  FROM flights
  GROUP BY year
  ORDER BY year;
")
```


### Q4
```{r}
# 4.1
dbGetQuery(con, "
           SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_flights
           FROM flights
           WHERE year = 2015
            AND month = 5
            AND day = 14
            AND dest = 'DFW';")

# 4.2
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT dest, COUNT(*) AS n_flights
  FROM flights
  WHERE year = 2015 AND origin = 'ORD'
  GROUP BY dest
  ORDER BY n_flights DESC
  LIMIT 10;
")

# 4.3
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT dest, AVG(arr_delay) AS avg_arr_delay, COUNT(*) AS n_flights
  FROM flights
  WHERE year = 2015
  GROUP BY dest
  ORDER BY avg_arr_delay DESC
  LIMIT 10;
")

# 4.4
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_flights
  FROM flights
  WHERE year = 2015
    AND (origin = 'BDL' OR dest = 'BDL');
")

# 4.5
dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT c.name AS airline, f.carrier, f.flight, f.origin, f.dest
  FROM flights AS f
  JOIN carriers AS c ON f.carrier = c.carrier
  WHERE f.year = 2015 AND f.month = 9 AND f.day = 26
    AND ((f.origin = 'LAX' AND f.dest = 'JFK')
      OR (f.origin = 'JFK' AND f.dest = 'LAX'))
  ORDER BY f.carrier, f.flight;
")

dbDisconnect(con)
```
